-- name: King_Tormax
-- Generated by scripts/quests/velious-simple.mjs; edit server/internal/quest/velious_simple_quests.json.
-- P99: https://wiki.project1999.com/Dain%27s_Head (sha256 913980637392f2ce51ad6cc8f8656f0f5f546913b33d67ccc8ee23746e28a74d)
-- Original: server/internal/quest/upstream/projecteq/kael/King_Tormax.lua (sha256 c295c056ef0903d9e0e5840e65767fbd0bb70b1cc9b36f9b90405f53bd2e2c84)
-- Reviewed P99 exchanges using existing quest primitives. Quest faction gating remains intentionally bypassed.
-- Only the reviewed Dain hand-in is restored. Unrelated Yelinak trade and combat-helper scripts are not activated by this batch; normal NPC combat is unchanged.
local item_lib = require("items")

function event_say(e)
  if e.message:findi("hail") then
    e.self:Say("Greetings. You know who I am, but I only vaguely know of you. My purpose is simple, I will rule these lands like my father, and my grandfather before him. All tasks but two are inconsequential to me.")
  elseif e.message:findi("task") then
    e.self:Say("The tasks are simple. I wish the death of the other powers of this frozen waste land. If you are able to destroy either of my mortal foes, bring me proof of your exploits and you will be known as the hero of Kael Drakkel.")
  elseif e.message:findi("power") then
    e.self:Emote("laughs deeply. I speak of the foolish old dragon Yelinak and that pitiful Dain Frostreaver.")
  end
end

function event_trade(e)
  if item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 30501 }) then
    e.self:Emote("laughs deeply as he takes the bloody head then gives you your reward.")
    e.other:SummonItem(25858)
    e.other:Faction(436, -250, 0)
    e.other:Faction(405, -250, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, 500, 0)
    e.other:Faction(429, 500, 0)
    e.other:AddEXP(250000)
  end
  -- Return unrelated and surplus offers on both accepted and rejected trades.
  item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end
